src: PLAN (phased; each phase gates the next
text:
DONE P1–P3 — 2026-09-13. Full enforcement live; every module at zero violations; suite green.

P1+P2 (committed): 15 new atoms in :core:designsystem — WloScreenTitle + titleL/caption ramp slots, WloCard(onClick/header/accent), WloSheet, WloBanner (single alpha convention 0.12/0.45), WloBadge/WloTag, WloListRow, WloRailButton, WloSwitchRow/WloSwitchColors, WloIconAction, WloBottomBar (M3 NavigationBar), WloDialog, WloProgress, WloEmptyState. Enforcement: uiAtoms rules in the existing architecture check (banned material3 structural imports, Surface(onClick, BorderStroke, Monospace, wloType.*.copy in :feature/*:app), severity property warn→enforce, build-logic self-tests 21/21. Warn baseline at flip: 214 violations / 9 modules.

P3 (7 agents, 3 waves): f01 (26→0), f02 (30→0, ActionRow fake-button family deleted), f03 (20→0) + f04 (21→0, incl. the "on — keep it on" fires-opposite-action bug fixed state-truthfully and DeductionToggle → real WloSwitchRow with set-semantics verified), f06 residuals (18→0) + f10 residuals (11→0, RailButton → WloRailButton, 5 card-clickables → WloCard(onClick), Settings affordance → WloIconAction), f12 (21→0, wire tokens → user words, StatusChip/StateBadge → WloBadge, switch skins centralized) + ZooScreen (9→0, byte format unified to decimal, raw model.id humanized), f13 (42→0, 21 raw buttons → atoms, glyph-radio FormatCard → clickable WloCard+badge, ✓/⚠ glyph junk removed, progress text → WloProgress), app shell (15→0: bottom bar → WloBottomBar, Settings rows → WloListRow, LockGate → atoms). Copy family fixed module-wide: sentence-case CTAs, spec-ID "R-B1" removed, rationale leaks deleted, ALL-CAPS shouts fixed, roadmap leak deleted, unreachable branch removed. Orchestrator micro-fix post-waves: pantry "item(s)" pluralization + 2 lowercase body lines.

FINAL STATE: `./gradlew checkArchitecture` with NO property → enforce mode, 0 violations across all 28 projects (independently re-run by orchestrator, exit 0). `:app:connectedDebugAndroidTest` → 55 tests / 24 classes / 0 failures (run 3, log /tmp/wlo-uifix-suite3.log). build-logic self-tests 21/21. ktlint/detekt green on all touched modules. testTags preserved (lanes diffed against HEAD); 11 androidTest files updated to the new ratified copy/controls (mapping in lane report; note: tab tags replaced by contentDescription lookup due to M3 NavigationBar).

Screenshots (8 routes): /tmp/wlo-uifix/p3-{onboard,hub,weight,plan,list,pantry,studio,vault}.png — visually verified by orchestrator: uppercase WloCardHeaders everywhere, single button grammar, real M3 navigation bar, consistent spacing. Disclosed out-of-scope touch: one pre-existing ktlint chain-wrap fix in core/data WeighInRepository.kt (committed in WLO-0030, blocked the green-check verification; formatter-only).

KNOWN FOLLOW-UPS (not violations, API friction noted by lanes): WloSwitchRow lacks enabled/secondary (disabled visuals); WloIcons carries only ChevronRight (3 lanes hand-built vectors in-module — promote a shared set); WloSheet has no header slot (sheet titles remain wloType.title Text — legal); formatBytes triplicated across f12/f13/zoo (needs a :core home); WloTextLink (low-emphasis header action) doesn't exist; determinate progress needs VM fractions.
